title: Landscape Maintenance and Common Close Cleaning Services Contract 2027-2029
description: The Contract will principally comprise landscape maintenance and common close cleaning services. The landscape maintenance services will mainly include litter picking, grass cutting, shrub bed, hedging and leaf collection to existing properties and common landscaped areas throughout Cardonald and Pollokshields, Glasgow to the areas detailed within the Landscape Architects tender drawings. The Contract may also include tree maintenance services, tree and stump removal works, and repairs to existing damaged grass and other landscaped areas. The landscape maintenance will initially be undertaken to estates located at St Andrews Drive, Queensland Community Garden and Halfway Community Park, however Southside Housing Association may introduce additional estates during the Contract that are located on the south side of Glasgow which shall be valued at the rates within Tender Document A where the maintenance requirements are similar in character. This contract is anticipated to include two estates where Southside Housing Association do not have landscape architects Maps or quantities at the date of inviting tenders. The Common Close Cleaning maintenance requirements will principally involve weekly internal and external cleaning to properties, and also monthly, quarterly & six monthly cleaning activities (refer Specification Items 1-21 described within Tender Document C ‘Common Close Cleaning Specification’ for further information). Bidders are also advised that Southside Housing Association may extend the common close cleaning requirement of the Contract to additional locations throughout the south side of Glasgow to take account of any changes to requirements or new stock acquired during the Contract. Bidders are also advised that Glasgow City Council are currently introducing an on-street bin replacement programme. If any of the common close cleaning properties listed in the tender documentation participate in Glasgow City Council’s on-street replacement programme in the future, cleaning of the existing bin store areas to the property may no longer be required during the Contract. In the event that cleaning of the bin store areas to a property is no longer required during the Contract, Southside Housing Association may instruct omission of the bin store cleaning to the property from the Contract and deduct the Contractor’s cost for the bin store cleaning to the property without loss or recompense to the Contractor. Southside Housing Association may also omit any of the landscape maintenance estates or common close cleaning properties listed within the tender documentation at any time during the Contract where a landscape maintenance estate or common close cleaning property is no longer in ownership, factored by Southside Housing Association or Southside Housing Association are unable to obtain authorisation to proceed with the services to a property where consent from factored owners has not been obtained. No loss or recompense will be due to the Contractor if Southside Housing Association omit any of the landscape maintenance estates or common close cleaning properties during the Contract where estates or properties are no longer in ownership or factored by Southside Housing Association, or where Southside Housing Association have been unable to obtain consent to proceed with the service from factored owners. The Contract term will be for an initial two year period commencing on 1st April 2027 with optional annual 1 year + 1 year + 1 year extensions up to a maximum contract completion date of 31st March 2032.

title: Tier 2 Adult Weight Management Service 2027
description: This procurement is being conducted in accordance with the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. Hampshire County Council's Public Health is seeking to procure a tier 2 adult weight management service designed to meet the needs of eligible Hampshire residents, based on National Institute of Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidelines. The service will be in two lots. Lot 1: Universal service a) A tier two weight management service, delivered face to face, at accessible venues across Hampshire along with a remote service (group or individual service) for people unable to access physical venues. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at a minimum of 70 locations across the County of Hampshire. b) A physical activity based tier 2 weight management service in which the behaviour change components of the tier 2 model are delivered alongside a physical activity intervention (co-determined by Commissioner and Provider) for male-only, female-only and mixed-sex groups. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at at a minimum of 70 locations across the County of Hampshire. title: France – Plant upgrade work – Marché Public Global de Performance sur les bâtiments communaux de la Ville de Miribel
description: La présente consultation concerne un Marché Global de Performance (MGP) passé selon la procédure du Dialogue Compétitif pour la conception-réalisation, l’exploitation-maintenance de 9 bâtiments et installations municipaux à rénover. Afin de garantir la bonne atteinte, mais également le respect dans le temps des performances, la contractualisation sous la forme d'un contrat global de performance énergétique est recherchée. De manière à garantir le meilleur choix, d’un point de vue technique, financier et opérationnel, ce contrat global est passé par la voie d’une procédure menée en dialogue compétitif. Le marché a donc pour objet : • les études de conception, • la réalisation des travaux, • ainsi que l’exploitation et la maintenance des bâtiments et installations concernées. • l’atteinte d’objectifs de performance énergétique contractualisés, • la réalisation de travaux fonctionnels sur certains sites, destinés à améliorer la qualité d’usage et les conditions d’accueil. Le recours à la procédure de dialogue compétitif est justifié par l’existence de prestations de conception et compte tenu de la nature du besoin ne pouvant être satisfait sans l’adaptation de solutions immédiatement disponibles.

buyer: Deutsches Zentrum für Neurodegenerative Erkrankungen e.V.
title: Germany – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Generalunternehmerleistungen DZNE CTU - Clinical Trial Unit Rostock
description: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die vollständige, funktionsfähige Errichtung einschließlich Fertigstellung einer Clinical Trial Unit (DZNE CTU) in Rostock als freistehender, dreigeschossiger Holzhybridbau. Der kubische Baukörper mit Abmessungen von ca. 23,80 m × 17,50 m wird ohne Unterkellerung errichtet. Vorgesehen ist eine Skeletttragstruktur mit nichttragenden, vorgefertigten Außenwänden in Holzrahmenbauweise. Das Gebäude dient der Durchführung klinischer Studien sowie der wissenschaftlichen Erprobung neuer Therapieverfahren im Frühstadium neurodegenerativer Erkrankungen. Die Nutzung umfasst Untersuchungs- und Diagnostikräume, einen Schwesternstützpunkt, Laborräume zur Aufbereitung biologischer Proben, Bettenzimmer zur kurzfristigen Beobachtung sowie einen Smart-Home-Bereich mit kleiner Wohnung für umfassende Monitoring-Studien. Die Generalunternehmerleistung umfasst die zur Realisierung des Bauvorhabens erforderlichen Bau-, Koordinations-, Prüf-, Abnahme-, Dokumentations- und Inbetriebnahmeleistungen, einschließlich der Planung gemäß der HOAI Leistungsphasen 5, 8 und 9, auf Basis der vom Generalplaner erbrachten Entwurfs- und Genehmigungsplanung.

title: Y1DA--Project620-22-110 Replace and Upgrade Fire alarm System at Montrose VAMC
description: This notice is for Solicitation Number 36C24227B0009, Project Number 620-22-110 Replace Fire Alarm Campus Wide at the VA Hudson Valley Health Care System, Montrose Campus, 2094 Albany Post Road, Montrose, New York 10548. This shall be a 100% Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside. As a result, all SDVOSBs may submit a bid, which will be considered by the agency. This project is classified under NAICS Code 238210 and has a size standard of $19 Million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $2,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00 Scope of Work: The scope of work shall generally consist of, but not limited to the following: The contractor will furnish all materials, equipment, supervision, and personnel necessary to complete the job to upgrade the fire alarm system campus wide at FDR VA Medical Center, Montrose Campus. General Construction: The existing Edwards system (EST) is unreliable and experiencing frequent trouble and supervisory signals associated with either the field devices or the modules within the control panels. This project will replace the existing Fire alarm system with the latest (2026) Honeywell s Notifier Fire alarm system with Intelligent addressable technology. These fire alarm devices will be able to report back to the main fire alarm command Control panel and notify the system as to the actual sensitivity setting and when they need to be cleaned and calibrated. The addressable control modules will also be used for typical control functions as releasing locked doors, Elevator controls, and shutdown of HVAC fan units. This is a multi-phased project that will upgrade the existing fire alarm system at the facility. Upon project completion, the VA will have addressed all deficiencies with the current fire alarm system. The upgraded system is designed to meet all NFPA codes and current guidelines. Project Completion: 550 Calendar Days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The solicitation will be released on or about November 12, 2026. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation. This project requires bonding and all responses/submissions to the solicitation to be posted later shall be emailed. No hand-carried bids will be accepted. All prospective bidders must be currently registered in www.sam.gov , www.dnb.com (Duns and Bradstreet )and be registered and verified as a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. End of Description.

title: USACE SPK DBB Construction - LAR C3B North - Sacramento, CA

North American Industry Classification (NAICS) code: 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. Product or Service Code: Y1LC, Construction of Tunnels and Subsurface Structures. description: The Government is seeking information on portable, RORO supplementary oxygen system solutions that may support MV-75 aircrew during extended-duration, high-altitude self-deployment operations. The Government is interested in self-generating approaches that can be installed and removed with minimal aircraft impact and without primary reliance on fixed-base oxygen-generation or refill infrastructure. The Government is particularly interested in systems that: � Support a minimum of two pilots and one nonrated crewmember for approximately seven hours at pressure altitudes up to 18,000 feet. � Generate, distribute, and deliver or otherwise provide breathing oxygen without primary reliance on stored oxygen cylinders. Respondents should identify any required stored-oxygen reserve. � Can be installed without significant permanent aircraft modification or extensive changes to aircraft systems. � Fit within the currently allocated installation envelope of approximately 2.5 cubic feet, with nominal dimensions of 0.8 feet wide, 1.3 feet deep, and 2.3 feet high. Solutions exceeding this preferred envelope may be considered if necessary to meet the operational need. � Address applicable physiological performance considerations, including breathing flow, mask pressure, work of breathing, oxygen concentration, gas temperature, and contaminant control. The Government anticipates considering applicable portions of MIL-STD-3050 and/or MIL-PRF-27210, the Army Military Airworthiness Certification Criteria (AMACC), and guiding miliary aircraft requirements as appropriate. � Do not impede aircrew movement, emergency egress, or access to individual weapons and required survival equipment. See Attachment for full requirements and submission instructions.

description: ***CHANGE: The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on or about December 16, 2026. THIS IS A PRESOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY: This announcement is issued solely for notification of the upcoming future solicitation to furnish gondola shelving systems, delivery, and installation services. This is not a solicitation and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or Request for Quotations (RFQ). DESCRIPTION AND PURPOSE: To maintain modern retail merchandising environments, ensure operational safety, and optimize retail floor space, DeCA requires reliable vendor partners to provide commercial shelving solutions. The Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) is seeking qualified, experienced sources capable of supplying, delivering, and installing standardized commercial gondola shelving systems across up to 12 selective worldwide commissary locations annually. The selected source(s) must furnish exact dimension components and/or performing onsite modifications to align with DeCA�s store planogram schematics for gondola shelving systems, delivery, and installation services across three geographic theaters, up to a maximum of 12 individual commissary locations per fiscal year (listed below). Optional incidental services may include: offloading merchandise from existing shelves, dismantling and removal of existing shelving systems, and restocking merchandise onto newly installed shelving systems. Geographic Theaters: CONUS: Continental United States OCONUS: Europe, Pacific, and other overseas military installations Non-Continental U.S. Territories and States: Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico The solicitation will be available for viewing and download on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) at www.SAM.gov, and proposal submissions will be conducted through the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE). The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on or about December 16, 2026. The contract award will be: Award: Full and Open - Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Period of Performance: one 12-months based period plus four 12-month option periods. title: C3BM ASE STRIKE Support
description: The Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management (PAE C3BM) is a Department of the Air Force organization located at Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts. However, they have multiple supporting locations across the continental United States (CONUS). PAE C3BM is responsible for the acquisition and delivery of the DAF BATTLE NETWORK, an integrated system-of-systems that connect sensors, effectors, and logistics systems to provide better situational awareness and faster decision-making for the joint force. This RFI focuses on experience related to systems engineering, architecture, and technical support to Department of Defense as well as modeling, knowledge management, data analysis, integration, and security. This RFI contains CUI and interested parties must be able to handle CUI and request access to the document through SAM.gov.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0005 POSTED 12/5. RFC #16 Response available in Attachments. AMENDMENT 0004 POSTED 12/3. AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the COR. The Period of Performance is expected to be 25 March 2026 to 29 May 2026. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. NOTE 1: Please pay particular attention to the inclusion of DFARS 252.232-7998 Obligations in Advance of Fiscal Year 2026 Funding (DEVIATION 2026-O0001). NOTE 2: Please review Request for Quote instructions regarding contract financing.

title: Y1DA--590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System
description: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 3 of 3 590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System This is a pre-solicitation announcement for the Department of Veterans Affairs. The Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6 intends to release a solicitation for construction services for project 590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System at the Hampton VA Health Care System in Hampton, VA. The design/build contractor (DB) shall be responsible for all required work associated with the removal, disposal of the old system, and installation of the new system. They shall provide all tools, labor, materials, equipment, supervision, professional services, and expertise required to perform all necessary work for the removal, disposal, installation, and activation. The design/build shall remove all pneumatic tube equipment and hardware from the current system. Work includes design and engineering, investigation and verification of existing conditions, removal and disposal of the existing pneumatic tube system and associated equipment, and procurement and installation of a new system in designated areas of Building 110, including the Blood Draw area, Mechanical Room, Interstitial Room, Emergency Department, and Laboratory. This announcement is a 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220, size standard $45M applies to this procurement. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The approximate solicitation issue date is November 16th, 2026. The Government intends to award a Firm Fixed Price Contract within 120 days from quote receipt date. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a request for submission of quotes. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to bring all necessary personnel, inclusive of subcontractors, tooling, and materials necessary for any site visit. The government will NOT be providing paper copies of any solicitation, solicitation attachments or annexes, specifications, or drawings. The government will NOT be reimbursing any costs associated with attendance or quote preparation. To be eligible for award, the SDVOSB must be registered and verified in the Small Business Administration Dynamic Small Business Search (SBA DSBS) see the following website: https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/. Potential offerors are further advised that failure to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) database will render your firm ineligible for award. The solicitation will be available only via the Internet at the following address: https://sam.gov/. Information on how to register your company, view or receive updates to this notice, please access https://sam.gov/. Any amendments to the solicitation will not be emailed but will be posted at the SAM website. Offerors are responsible for obtaining solicitation documents from SAM and acknowledging all amendments to any subsequent solicitation. No paper copies of the impending solicitation will be furnished. No email, fax, or telephone inquiries will be answered as a result of this announcement. No other information regarding scope, dates, etc. is available until issuance of the solicitation. The date and time for site visit will be stated in the issued solicitation. No other site visits will be conducted.

title: Acquisition de véhicules de patrouille de même type pour la police zougoise
description:
La police zougoise doit remplacer, au cours de l’année 2027, la flotte de véhicules actuelle de la police d’intervention. Les véhicules doivent pouvoir être utilisés toute l’année, 24 heures sur 24, par tous les temps et sur l’ensemble du territoire cantonal. En outre, le matériel d’équipement et d’intervention transporté doit pouvoir être rangé de manière fonctionnelle et de façon à préserver le matériel.

Le kilométrage annuel prévu pour ce type de véhicule est d’environ 40’000 km par véhicule, avec une charge utile prévue d’environ 500 kg. La durée d’utilisation envisagée est d’environ 10 ans.

Le présent appel d’offres vise à sélectionner une soumissionnaire en mesure de fournir les véhicules requis, y compris les prestations de garantie et de service. Un contrat-cadre d’une durée de cinq ans pour la livraison de véhicules sera conclu avec l’adjudicataire.


L’objet du marché comprend sept véhicules neufs complets et en état de circuler, de type SUV (cf. chapitre 3 du cahier des charges), équipés de tous les dispositifs et équipements conformes à l’état actuel de la technique et aux exigences actuelles en matière de sécurité. Au cours des années contractuelles suivantes, l’acquisition de trois véhicules supplémentaires au maximum est envisagée.

L’ensemble de l’objet du marché est optionnel. Aucune garantie d’acquisition n’est accordée.


L’aménagement des véhicules ne fait pas partie du présent appel d’offres.

title: Denmark – Medical equipments – Genudbud af diabetesteknologi
description: Udbuddet gennemføres af de ordregivende myndigheder som et fælles udbud, jf. § 123, stk. 5. Udbuddet er omfattet af udbudsloven (lov nr. 1564 af 15. december 2015 med senere ændringer), som implementerer udbudsdirektivet (direktiv 2014/24/EU). Udbuddet vedrører Region Midtjyllands, Region Syddanmarks, Region Nordjyllands og Region Østdanmarks (Nuværende Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden) indkøb af diabetesteknologi fordelt på to delkontrakter vedrørende henholdsvis (1) AID-insulinpumpesystemer og (2) kontinuerlige sensorbaserede glukosemålingssystemer (CGM). Udbuddet omfatter desuden de systemkomponenter, det tilbehør og de forbrugsvarer, der er nødvendige eller relevante for at tage de tilbudte systemer i brug og anvende dem som forudsat. Som en integreret del af leverancen skal leverandørerne endvidere stille de tilhørende digitale løsninger til rådighed, herunder apps samt patient- og klinikerplatforme, og levere oplæring af patienter og sundhedspersonale samt teknisk support til patienter. De omfattede produkter fremgår af Kontraktbilag 3, mens kravene til produkterne og de tilknyttede ydelser fremgår af Kontrakten og Kravspecifikationen, jf. Kontraktbilag 2. Den udbudte kontrakt, herunder delkontrakt (1) og (2), er rammeaftaler i henhold til udbudslovens § 24, nr. 30. Delkontrakt 1 og Delkontrakt 2 er separate rammeaftaler. Tildeling af ordrer på rammeaftalerne sker på følgende måde: Ordregiver vil tildele de efterfølgende ordrer blandt de leverandører, der er indgået aftale med, ved brug af (1) en kaskademodel, såfremt Ordregivers anskaffelse til en given patient kun omfatter produkter fra enten Delaftale 1 eller Delaftale 2, (2) en varekurvsmodel, såfremt Ordregivers anskaffelse til en patient både omfatter produkter under Delaftale 1 og produkter under Delaftale 2, eller (3) en behovsmodel, såfremt en konkret lægefaglig vurdering tilsiger, at den enkelte patient grundet helbred, behandling og/eller livssituation, skal have et bestemt(e) produkt(er). Kaskademodel: Ordrer på de enkelte delkontrakter vil blive placeret ved direkte tildeling hos den leverandør, der har afgivet det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud, og hvis denne ikke kan levere, kan Ordregiver tildele ordren til den næste leverandør i rækken, jf. dog varekurvsmodellen og behovsmodellen. Varekurvsmodel: Såfremt Ordregivers anskaffelse til en patient både omfatter produkter under Delaftale 1 og produkter under Delaftale 2 vil Ordregiver tildele til de Leverandører, der på tværs af Delaftale 1 og Delaftale 2 tilsammen giver den laveste pris for Ordregiver, jf. dog behovsmodellen. Behovsmodel: Såfremt den eller de Leverandører, som ellers ville blive tildelt ordren efter kaskademodellen eller varekurvsmodellen, ikke kan levere det system, som ved en konkret lægefaglig vurdering er det bedste for den enkelte patients helbred, behandling og/eller livssituation, kan Ordregiver tildele ordren til den af de øvrige Leverandører, som kan levere et system, der i det konkrete tilfælde kan være væsentligt bedre for patientens helbred, behandling eller livssituation. Ved denne konkrete lægefaglige vurdering foretages en samlet vurdering af de tilbudte systemer, herunder de Forbrugsvarer, der er tilbudt som en del af systemet, i det omfang disse har betydning for patientens helbred, behandling eller livssituation. Der henvises også til beskrivelse i udbudsbetingelsernes pkt. 14. I forbindelse med kontraktindgåelsen vil der blive udfærdiget separate kontrakter og kontraktbilag (undtagen kontraktbilag 5, som allerede indgår i udbudsmaterialet i et eksemplar for hver deltagende region) for hver af de øvrige deltagende regioner. Det vil sige hver region indgår separate kontrakter/rammeaftaler med de vindende tilbudsgivere.
